- Initial release of the autism-analysis skill.
- Provides automated video analysis for identifying behavioral characteristics of children with autism.
- Generates structured analysis reports with early intervention recommendations.
- Enforces strict data privacy: all historical report queries must use cloud APIs; local memory/history files are strictly prohibited.
- Implements mandatory open-id acquisition procedures before processing any analysis.
- Supports both online video URLs and local uploads for analysis; results include core symptom evaluation and markdown-formatted report lists.
